description: MIREX 2% CHG Skin Prep is a comprehensive disinfectant that requires no supplementary products for dressing in minor surgical procedures.

composition: Chlorhexidine Gluconate 2.0 % W/V (Equivalent to Chlorhexidine Gluconate Solution IP 10 % V/V)

mode_of_use: Skin disinfection: Wet with a swab of MIREX 2% CHG Skin Prep, in the area to be disinfected and allow to dry
range_of_application: Used before and during catheterization, as well as during dressing changes
Skin treatment before applying casts for fractures

salient_features: MIREX 2% CHG is microbicidal against all bacteria including MRSA, EHEC, fungi and viruses
It has a residual effect throughout the procedure
Rapid healing of skin after surgery
It is highly effective in the prevention of CRBSI and CVC colonization
It can be used to clean the site prior to CVC insertion and also the maintenance of catheters

spectrum: Microbicidal against all bacteria including MRSA and EHEC
clinical_claims: Prevention of CVC (Central Venous Catheter) colonization

ideal_for: Dressing changes and post-suturing site cleaning
key_strengths: Persistent residual effect throughout the procedure
30 second dry time, 15 second exposure time
